source: Field survey from 5 local sellers and repair centers, Sri Lanka 2026

knocking.description: Engine bearing or piston repair — requires workshop strip-down

misfiring.description: Spark plug replacement, ignition coil or injector cleaning

rotational_imbalance.description: Engine mount replacement or rotating component balancing

battery_fault.description: Battery replacement LKR 25,500-28,000 plus starter motor if needed LKR 12,000

engine_health._note: Engine deduction is based on component 3's Mechanical Health Score (MHS) colour, not the fault name, because component 3 is reliable at healthy vs faulty but weaker at naming the fault. typical_* cover all surveyed engine faults above; expected is the average of their midpoints.

amber.description: Possible engine problem - partial repair cost deducted, have a mechanic check it

red.description: Likely engine fault - full typical repair cost deducted

vin_policy._note: Policy setting, not an estimate: a VIN the system could not confirm carries legal and resale risk, so the fair value is discounted and the car can never be shown as a good deal.

body_damage_categories._score_bands: Lowest body_score (from component 2) for each category. Aligned with component 2's condition labels: 100 = no damage, 90-99 Excellent, 60-89 Good/Fair, below 60 Poor/Severely damaged.

minor.description: Surface scratches, small dents, minor paint chips

moderate.description: Dented panels, broken lights, damaged bumpers

severe.description: Multiple damaged panels, bonnet, door replacement, full repaint
